name.value: Port Moody Arts Centre (Old City Hall)

description.value: A community arts centre and Port Moody's official Visitor Centre, housed in the historic Old City Hall building in the heart of the city. It offers a contemporary art gallery with rotating exhibitions, a co-op gift shop featuring local artists' work, and over 350 arts classes annually. For touring cyclists passing through Port Moody, it doubles as a visitor information stop where staff can point you to local businesses and attractions.
